headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage As Northern Sectors Churn
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Callahan's Passage, Palantine Berm, and Kuura Strand have emerged as the sharpest flashpoints on the map, each recording brisk base turnover and heavy engagements into the latest hours. In Callahan's Passage, intense fighting around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage generated more than 2,500 casualties over the last two hours alone. Palantine Berm registered five rapid transitions across The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni, while Kuura Strand logged repeated exchanges at Suosalo and Talven amid steady bloodshed. Across the broader northern theatre, Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Nevish Line continue to bear massive casualty totals, though their structural line exchanges have momentarily cooled following dozens of earlier base captures. Meanwhile, Mooring County exhibits accelerating casualty rates in the wake of earlier fighting at The Wind Hills, while the southern territories remain firmly tranquil under undisturbed Colonial administration.
